title: prusik update never closes a legacy finding that has no ticket, even when its fix shipped
detail: feedback.jsonl records filed before tickets existed (or whose ticket write failed) have no findings/fb-<id>.json. update_cmd._close_shipped_findings and feedback_store.close_shipped iterate tickets only, so those findings stay open forever. One adopter on 2026-11-20: 5 of its 12 open findings (fb-91c75e51c214, fb-9f107742fe4d, fb-b4eb142e5740, fb-bc87bb8520dc, fb-d4d401114c19) are in _closures.json and shipped in its pinned 0.254.0, but have no ticket. HQ loop_closure reads findings/ too, so they are invisible there as well. prusik feedback migrate exists, but nothing runs it.
